statements: def common (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) : Finset V := e 0 ∩ e 1 ∩ e 2
def blockA (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) : Finset V := (e 0 ∩ e 1) \ e 2
def blockB (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) : Finset V := (e 1 ∩ e 2) \ e 0
def blockC (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) : Finset V := (e 0 ∩ e 2) \ e 1
(blockA e).Nonempty ∧ (blockB e).Nonempty ∧ (blockC e).Nonempty

def privateBlock (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) : Fin 3 → Finset V :=
  ![e 0 \ (e 1 ∪ e 2), e 1 \ (e 0 ∪ e 2), e 2 \ (e 0 ∪ e 1)]

BooleanLaw {v // v ∈ e} ≃ {μ : BooleanLaw V // restrictLaw μ e = μ} where
  toFun ν := ⟨edgeLawToAmbient e ν, restrictLaw_edgeLawToAmbient e ν⟩
  invFun μ := ambientToEdgeLaw e μ.val
  left_inv := ambientToEdgeLaw_edgeLawToAmbient e
  right_inv μ := Subtype.ext ((edgeLawToAmbient_ambientToEdgeLaw e μ.val).trans μ.property)

 theorem moment_edgeLawToAmbient (e s : Finset V) (hs : s ⊆ e)
    (ν : BooleanLaw {v // v ∈ e}) :
    moment (edgeLawToAmbient e ν) s = moment ν (edgeProject e s) := by
  rw [moment, edgeLawToAmbient, Law.prob_map, moment]
  exact ν.prob_congr (fun x => subset_edgeEmbed_iff e s hs x)

 theorem moment_ambientToEdgeLaw (e s : Finset V) (hs : s ⊆ e) (μ : BooleanLaw V) :
    moment (ambientToEdgeLaw e μ) (edgeProject e s) = moment μ s := by
  rw [← moment_edgeLawToAmbient e s hs, edgeLawToAmbient_ambientToEdgeLaw,
    moment_restrict μ e s hs]

theorem mass_eq_signed_moments {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

      (-1 : ℝ) ^ W.card * moment μ (O ∪ W)

def cycleDistinguishedRelaxation (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) (hc : Geometry.IsCycle e)
    (hv : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ e i) : Set (ofThree e hc hv).completion.Vector :=
  cycleCoordinates e hc hv ⁻¹'
    AlphaCycle.distinguishedRelaxation e (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hc)

(hv : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ e i) : Set (ofThree e hc hv).completion.Vector :=
  cycleCoordinates e hc hv ⁻¹'

(hc : Geometry.IsCycle e) (hv : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ e i) :
    cycleAllRelaxation e hc hv =
      (ofThree e hc hv).completion.completeEdgeRelaxation ∩
      {z | ∀ f : SupportedCycle e, ∀ U : Finset V,
        generalizedTriangle e f.edge f.supported
          (switchVector e U (cycleCoordinates e hc hv z))} := by
  ext z
  exact and_congr (ofThree_mem_completeEdgeRelaxation_iff e hc hv z).symm Iff.rfl

(hc : Geometry.IsCycle e) (hv : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ e i)
    (hlarge : 2 ≤ (Geometry.blockA e).card ∨ 2 ≤ (Geometry.blockB e).card ∨
      2 ≤ (Geometry.blockC e).card) :
    (cycleAllRelaxation e hc hv \ (ofThree e hc hv).completion.polytope).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hn⟩ := AlphaCycle.allCycle_gap_nonempty e hc hlarge
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := hz.1 0
  have h0 : z ⟨∅, mem_completedSupport_of_subset e 0 ∅ (Finset.empty_subset _)⟩ = 1 := by
    rw [← hμ ∅ (Finset.empty_subset _), moment_empty]
  have hcoord := cycleCoordinates_cycleFromMoment e hc hv z h0
  refine ⟨cycleFromMoment e hc hv z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change cycleCoordinates e hc hv (cycleFromMoment e hc hv z) ∈
      AlphaCycle.allCycleRelaxation e
    rwa [hcoord]
  · intro hp
    apply hn
    have hh := (ofThree_mem_polytope_iff e hc hv _).mp hp
    rwa [hcoord] at hh

(hc : Geometry.IsCycle e) (hv : ∀ v, ∃ i, v ∈ e i) :
    (ofThree e hc hv).completion.polytope ⊆ cycleAllRelaxation e hc hv ∧
    cycleAllRelaxation e hc hv ⊆ cycleDistinguishedRelaxation e hc hv ∧
    cycleDistinguishedRelaxation e hc hv ⊆
      (ofThree e hc hv).completion.completeEdgeRelaxation := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    exact multilinearPolytope_subset_allCycleRelaxation e
      ((ofThree_mem_polytope_iff e hc hv z).mp hz)
  · intro z hz
    exact allCycleRelaxation_subset_distinguishedRelaxation e
      (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hc) hz
  · intro z hz
    exact (ofThree_mem_completeEdgeRelaxation_iff e hc hv z).mpr hz.1

theorem selected_witness_gap (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) (u v b c : V)
    (hu : u ∈ Geometry.blockA e) (hv : v ∈ Geometry.blockA e)
    (hb : b ∈ Geometry.blockB e) (hc : c ∈ Geometry.blockC e) (huv : u ≠ v) :
    witness e u v b c ∈ allCycleRelaxation e ∧
    witness e u v b c ∉ multilinearPolytope (completedSupport e)

theorem reduced_subcycle_structure (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) (f : SupportedCycle e) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
      let g := fun i => f.edge (σ i)
      (∀ i, g i ⊆ e i) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (subcycleBlock g i) (subcycleBlock g j)) ∧
      (g 0 = blockA g ∪ blockC g ∪ common g ∧
       g 1 = blockA g ∪ blockB g ∪ common g ∧
       g 2 = blockB g ∪ blockC g ∪ common g) ∧
      blockA g ⊆ blockA e ∪ common e ∧
      blockB g ⊆ blockB e ∪ common e ∧
      blockC g ⊆ blockC e ∪ common e ∧ common g ⊆ common e

theorem witness_in_allCycleRelaxation (e : Fin 3 → Finset V) (u v b c : V)
    (huv : u ≠ v) (hu : u ∉ e 2) (hv : v ∉ e 2) (hb : b ∉ e 0) (hc : c ∉ e 1) :
    witness e u v b c ∈ allCycleRelaxation e

theorem singleton_private_block_reduction (e : Fin 3 → Finset V)
    (a b c : V) (ha : blockA e = {a}) (hb : blockB e = {b}) (hc : blockC e = {c})
    (μ : Fin 3 → BooleanLaw V) :
    (∃ ρ : BooleanLaw V, ∀ i, restrictLaw ρ (e i) = restrictLaw (μ i) (e i)) ↔
    (∃ ν : BooleanLaw V, restrictLaw ν (common e ∪ {a, b, c}) = ν ∧
      ∀ i, restrictLaw ν (e i \ privateBlock e i) =
        restrictLaw (μ i) (e i \ privateBlock e i))

theorem restore_private_blocks
    {K E₁ E₂ E₃ D₁ D₂ D₃ : Type*}
    [Fintype K] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂] [Fintype E₃]
    [Fintype D₁] [Fintype D₂] [Fintype D₃]
    (μ : Law K) (ν₁ : Law (E₁ × D₁)) (ν₂ : Law (E₂ × D₂)) (ν₃ : Law (E₃ × D₃))
    (f₁ : K → E₁) (f₂ : K → E₂) (f₃ : K → E₃)
    (h₁ : μ.map f₁ = ν₁.map Prod.fst)
    (h₂ : μ.map f₂ = ν₂.map Prod.fst)
    (h₃ : μ.map f₃ = ν₃.map Prod.fst) :
    ∃ glued : Law (((K × D₁) × D₂) × D₃),
      glued.map (fun x => x.1.1.1) = μ ∧
      glued.map (fun x => (f₁ x.1.1.1, x.1.1.2)) = ν₁ ∧
      glued.map (fun x => (f₂ x.1.1.1, x.1.2)) = ν₂ ∧
      glued.map (fun x => (f₃ x.1.1.1, x.2)) = ν₃

theorem distinguished_exact_of_singletons (e : Fin 3 → Finset V)
    (hcycle : Geometry.IsCycle e) (hs : Geometry.Singletons e) :
    distinguishedRelaxation e (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle) =
      multilinearPolytope (completedSupport e)

(hcycle : Geometry.IsCycle e) (hs : Geometry.Singletons e) :
    distinguishedRelaxation e (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle) =
      multilinearPolytope (completedSupport e) := by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hcons⟩ := (mem_completeEdgeRelaxation_iff_consistent e z).1 hz.1
    obtain ⟨a, b, c, hA, hB, hC, hab, hac, hbc, ha, hb, hc⟩ :=
      Geometry.singleton_vertices e hs
    have h₀ : (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle).edge 0 =
        Geometry.common e ∪ {a, c} := by
      simp only [Geometry.distinguishedCycle, Geometry.reduced, Geometry.reduced0,
        hA, hC, Finset.union_assoc, Finset.singleton_union]
    have h₁ : (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle).edge 1 =
        Geometry.common e ∪ {a, b} := by
      simp only [Geometry.distinguishedCycle, Geometry.reduced, Geometry.reduced1,
        hA, hB, Finset.union_assoc, Finset.singleton_union]
    have h₂ : (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle).edge 2 =
        Geometry.common e ∪ {b, c} := by
      simp only [Geometry.distinguishedCycle, Geometry.reduced, Geometry.reduced2,
        hB, hC, Finset.union_assoc, Finset.singleton_union]
    have hparent : ∀ i, (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle).edge i ⊆ e i :=
      fun _ => Finset.inter_subset_right
    have hcore := singleton_core_consistent e a b c hA hB hC μ hcons
    have htri := SliceBridge.triangleConditions_of_distinguished e
      (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle) z hz μ hμ (Geometry.common e) a b c
      ha hb hc hab hac hbc h₀ h₁ h₂ hparent hcore
    apply (mem_multilinearPolytope_iff_realizes e z μ hμ).2
    exact singleton_realization_of_slices e a b c hA hB hC ha hb hc hab hac hbc μ hcons htri
  · exact (multilinearPolytope_subset_allCycleRelaxation e).trans
      (allCycleRelaxation_subset_distinguishedRelaxation e (Geometry.distinguishedCycle e hcycle))
